disambiguation: Not a general language learning tool; it is a utility for translating selected text and full documents.
extras: Translation is only offline when the selected endpoint is local, such as a local Ollama server. Do not send sensitive or restricted documents to a service you do not trust.
problem: Users face difficulty translating selected text or entire academic PDFs within Obsidian, especially when dealing with complex formatting or specialized language pairs.

relations.evidence: Parts of the translation-provider request logic were adapted from Translate for Zotero, licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later, and modified for Mini Translator in 2026.

summary: A desktop plugin that translates selected text and academic PDFs using built-in services or OpenAI-compatible models.
